grading_rules: Read the question, complete saved candidate, canonical reference, supplied evidence, and existing original-paper adjudications. Never use judge or VeriFin verdicts as correctness evidence.
Bare numeric answers may use the amount or ratio requested by the question. Accept equivalent quantities and requested rounding; explicit signs, relevant quantity, and all required components matter.
A qualitative answer is correct when it conveys the requested substantive meaning; exact wording and unnecessary additional details are not required.
Evaluate a supplied numerical arithmetic expression from its own operands only. Do not fill missing numbers from the gold answer or infer an unprovided amount from symbolic variable names.
Redaction placeholders, a lone dash, and answers omitting a required amount or component are incorrect.
Retain canonical benchmark targets and existing adjudications; disclose question/reference interpretation disputes and hypothetical benchmark assumptions. Do not silently correct reference data.
